'''Great Jungle Outfitters''', founded by [[Joodiel Amgris]], was a personal outfitting company that was based on [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]]. It provided hunting gear and supplies for safari hunts taking place on that [[Planet/Legends|world]].<ref name="FC">{{JournalCite|1|First Contact}}</ref>
